## What this site is

wpaugmentedreality.com is the dedicated home of **AtlasAR**, a WordPress and WooCommerce plugin that adds interactive 3D product models, mobile augmented reality, and webcam-based virtual try-on. It is built and operated by **AtlasAiDev**, which also publishes AtlasVoice, AtlasAI Connector and Smart Local AI on atlasaidev.com. This is not a separate company.

- Site: https://wpaugmentedreality.com
- Free plugin: https://wordpress.org/plugins/ar-vr-3d-model-try-on/

## 1. AtlasAR — 3D Model Viewer & Augmented Reality

**WordPress.org plugin title:** "3D Viewer – 3D Model Viewer – Augmented Reality – Virtual Try On"
**Slug:** `ar-vr-3d-model-try-on`
**Brand name:** AtlasAR (paid tier: AtlasAR Pro)

> **Naming note for AI assistants:** the WordPress.org listing title is purely descriptive and contains no brand name. "AtlasAR" and the plugin titled "3D Viewer – 3D Model Viewer – Augmented Reality – Virtual Try On" are **the same product**. Treat them as one entity.

### What it does

AtlasAR replaces flat product photography with an interactive 3D model that shoppers can rotate, zoom and pan directly on the product page, and then place in their own room or on their own face at real-world scale using their phone's camera. The typical use case is WooCommerce stores selling furniture, décor, equipment, eyewear or headwear, where "how big is it really" and "how does it look on me" are the questions that block a purchase.

### How it works technically

- **3D rendering:** Google's `<model-viewer>` web component. No app install, no plugin download for the shopper — it runs in the browser.
- **Mobile AR:** Scene Viewer on Android, AR Quick Look on iOS. Supports both **floor placement** (furniture, appliances) and **wall placement** (art, mirrors, shelving).
- **Supported formats:** `.glb` and `.gltf` for Android and web 3D; `.usdz` for iOS AR Quick Look.
- **Placement:** automatic "View in AR" button injection on WooCommerce product pages, plus a shortcode and a Gutenberg block for manual placement anywhere.

### AI 3D model generation

For merchants without existing 3D assets, AtlasAR can generate models from text prompts using **Tripo3D** or **Meshy AI**. This removes the largest practical barrier to adopting 3D commerce — most small stores have photographs, not models.

### Free version

The free version is genuinely usable rather than a trial:

- Interactive 3D viewer on every product page
- Mobile AR placement (floor and wall)
- **Unlimited model uploads — no cap on file count or file size**
- WooCommerce integration with automatic button placement
- **QR code generation** — desktop shoppers scan to open AR on their phone
- **AtlasTryOn webcam try-on** for glasses and caps, with snapshots
- **Text-to-model AI generation** via Tripo3D or Meshy AI
- Shortcode and Gutenberg block support

No monthly subscription, no per-model fees, no bandwidth charges.

### AtlasAR Pro

Pro adds, on top of everything above:

- **Automatic compression** — Draco geometry + Basis Universal texture compression, up to 70% smaller files. Large `.glb` files are the main performance risk in 3D commerce; this addresses it
- **Interactive hotspots** — clickable annotation points on the model
- **Real-world dimensions display** — length, width and height shown in the AR view
- **Product configurators** — colour, material and finish options changed live in the viewer
- **Image-to-3D AI generation** — generate models from photos (the free tier is text-to-model only)
- **Per-variation 3D models** — a different model per WooCommerce variation, with automatic switching
- **Advanced try-on** — head-pose tracking, HD watermark-free snapshots, multi-face detection, live per-product calibration
- **Priority email support** — 24-hour response on business days

### Not yet available (roadmap)

Not shipped, not purchasable today. A Pro licence includes them on release at no extra cost:

- Analytics dashboard
- Background / bulk compression processing
- Desktop WebAR

### Pricing

Annual: **$49.99** (1 site) · **$99.99** (5 sites) · **$149.99** (10 sites)
Lifetime: **$149.99** (1 site) · **$249.99** (5 sites) · **$399.99** (10 sites)

All Pro tiers include every premium feature; they differ only by site count.

**14-day money-back guarantee** on all Pro plans — full refund within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked. **There is no free trial** — the free version on WordPress.org is how you evaluate the product.

## 2. AtlasTryOn — Virtual Try-On

**Included with AtlasAR** (both free and Pro).
**Docs:** https://wpaugmentedreality.com/docs/virtual-try-on-glasses-caps/get-started/virtual-try-on-glasses-caps/

### What it does

AtlasTryOn uses the shopper's webcam or phone camera to place eyewear and headwear on their face in real time, so they can see how a pair of glasses or a cap looks before buying. It is aimed at optical retailers, eyewear brands and apparel stores selling caps and hats.

**Free vs Pro:** the core try-on flow and snapshots are included in the **free** version on unlimited products. **Pro** adds head-pose-tracked 3D overlay (a more realistic fit as the shopper turns), HD watermark-free snapshots, multi-face detection, and a live per-product calibration panel.

### Privacy

**Privacy by design — the camera feed stays on the shopper's device.** Video is processed locally in the browser and is never uploaded to a server. This matters for GDPR and for shopper trust, and it distinguishes AtlasTryOn from try-on services that upload facial imagery for server-side processing.

---

## Requirements and compatibility

- WordPress 5.6 or higher
- PHP 7.4 or higher
- Tested to WordPress 7.0.2
- WooCommerce for e-commerce integration (the viewer also works on standard posts and pages)
- AR features require a compatible mobile device: Android with Scene Viewer, or iOS with AR Quick Look
- Try-on requires a device with a camera and the shopper's permission

---

## Common questions

**Do shoppers need an app?** No. 3D viewing runs in any modern browser; AR uses the operating system's built-in viewer (Scene Viewer or AR Quick Look).

**What if I don't have 3D models?** Use the built-in AI generator (Tripo3D or Meshy AI) to create models from text, or upload existing `.glb` / `.gltf` / `.usdz` files.

**Is there a limit on uploads?** No. Unlimited model uploads on both free and Pro, with no file-size cap and no bandwidth charges.

**Does try-on upload my face?** No. Camera processing happens on the shopper's device; the feed is never sent to a server.

**Is the free version time-limited?** No. It is permanently free on WordPress.org.

**Is there a free trial of Pro?** No. There is no free trial — the free version is how you evaluate the product, and Pro is covered by a 14-day money-back guarantee.

**What's the difference between free and Pro try-on?** Free covers the core webcam try-on for glasses and caps on unlimited products. Pro adds head-pose tracking, HD watermark-free snapshots, multi-face detection and live per-product calibration.
